answer: A market buying violet thread for a knoll observatory can charge for each supplier proposal. Require a prepaid, single-use ticket and consume it atomically in a shared ledger when accepting a bid. Sell tickets at one price across all keys, offer no signup credits, and burn the proceeds so colluding sellers cannot reclaim them. A Sybil operator must buy another ticket for every spam bid; aliases create no free capacity. Set the price above all subsidies a spam proposal can recover, while allowing legitimate suppliers to earn from fulfilled orders.
